tools.description: Trigger the scheduled bookmark-check and maintenance jobs via the cron URL. The token must match the configured system cron token; otherwise it is refused.

summary: LinkAce is a self-hosted bookmark manager (Laravel 11): registered users create and organize Link records with Tags and Lists through m2m relations, attach Notes to links, share links by visibility (public/internal/private), search and filter links, bulk-edit, import/export HTML bookmarks via queue jobs, monitor link status (OK/MOVED/BROKEN) with a scheduled checker that emails notifications, back links up to the Wayback Machine, and manage users/roles/API tokens; admins set system/guest settings stored as key-value rows, and a REST API (sanctum tokens) exposes the same CRUD and trash workflows.
